scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run -s dist/firefox
scripts.pack:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build -s dist/firefox -a dist --overwrite-dest
scripts.pack:chrome: npm run build:chrome && rm -f dist/timepeek-chrome-unpacked.zip && (cd dist && zip -r timepeek-chrome-unpacked.zip chrome)
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --channel unlisted
